_**Agent (claude-opus-4-5-20251101)**_

SentencePiece is **CPU-only** - it doesn't support GPU acceleration and won't automatically use your GPU.

The training algorithm (BPE) is inherently sequential: it iteratively counts and merges the most frequent byte pairs, which doesn't parallelize well on GPU architectures.

Your notebook is already using the best available optimization:

```python
num_threads=os.cpu_count()
```

This uses all CPU cores, which is the maximum parallelization SentencePiece supports.

**Good news:** For a 35MB corpus like yours, tokenizer training typically completes in under a minute on modern CPUs anyway, so GPU acceleration wouldn't make a meaningful difference even if it existed.
